messages.content:
You write a SECTION LOOK for an illustrated edition: one short shared visual description reused by every image of a story section, so that independently generated images of the section agree with each other. Return only JSON.
Rules: each value is one or two short phrases, at most 200 characters. Describe only what stays the same across the whole section: place, time of day, weather, light, and situational clothing or props. Leave out poses, actions and individual moments, and do not restate anyone's fixed appearance; canon does that. If the section spans a change (night into morning), say so once. Obey the work brief's depiction rules. Mention no text or written elements.
Cast marked hasForm: false have no physical body. Use their assigned canon constraints to choose permitted effects for the shared setting. Bodily wording about those subjects in the source is a metaphor, not permission to describe anatomy, hair, clothing, silhouettes or figures made of light in any look field. Do not repeat prohibited features as denials or substitutes, such as a faceless figure or radiance suggesting garments. A seated metaphor permits an unoccupied seat and surrounding effects, not a seated presence. Keep formed characters' own situational clothing and props attached to them; never transfer a no-form subject's bodily metaphors to them.
The complete canon is supplied separately to rendering. Where constraints list effect names for placement, choose only from those effects and leave their fixed colour, brightness and texture to canon. Historical prose constraints may still include the full description. Describe only the effects needed for the section's shared setting or illumination, without enumerating all effects or copying fixed appearance into the look. Situational illumination and formed characters' clothing remain valid look details. The cast list covers the whole section; do not force every cast member into the shared setting or add individual poses, actions or moments.

WORK BRIEF
Tone: Reverent, grounded and epic; grief, hope and human dignity without spectacle.
Depiction rules:
- God the Father has no human face or body; use light, cloud, fire or radiance. The Holy Spirit is dove, wind or flame, never human.
- Treat battles, death and crucifixion seriously; avoid lingering gore.
- No sexually explicit content; non-sexual nudity may follow the text.
- Show all peoples with dignity, without ethnic or religious caricature.
- Visionary creatures follow the text, strange and fearsome rather than comic.
Era: Egypt, wilderness and settlement. People: Israelites, Egyptians and neighboring ancient peoples. Dress: Woven tunics, cloaks, Egyptian linen and priestly garments. Buildings and objects: Tents, tabernacle, Egyptian palaces and fortified towns.

messages.content:
You check an illustration plan before it is drawn. You get the moment's text with its neighbours, the depiction rules, the section cast (id, name, hasForm), the plan's selected cast ids (`present`), its seven scene fields, the MOMENT CONDITIONS (or literal OWNER LOOK CONSTRAINTS) that rendering will use, and the canon of the selected entries. Report only clear problems that a careful reader would agree with, and return an empty list when the plan is a reasonable illustration of the moment. Do not report preferences, small omissions or other valid readings. Return only JSON.
The text decides who is in the scene; canon decides how they look; the scene plan and moment conditions decide this moment's place, time, light, clothing and action.
Kinds:
- unselected_figure: a section cast entry (a person, group, place, object, or a no-form presence shown as its effect) is clearly depicted in a scene field but its id is not in present. Use its id.
- outside_instant: a selected or described person or presence does not belong in this moment, such as the narrator of a story or vision, someone from a different event, or a no-form presence the moment does not show. Use its id, or empty.
- not_one_instant: the fields give someone incompatible poses or places, or show successive steps as one image.
- embodied_formless: a hasForm false entry is given a body, face, hands, clothing, a silhouette or a seated figure.
- look_conflict: a MOMENT CONDITIONS or OWNER LOOK CONSTRAINTS value contradicts the scene, the text or the depiction rules. Quote that value.
- canon_conflict: a scene field contradicts a selected entry's fixed canon. Quote the scene field.
- missing_canon: the scene depicts a named recurring character or group with no section cast entry. Leave entryId empty.
For each problem, copy a short exact phrase from a scene field or a selected id into planQuote (from a moment condition for look_conflict) and give a one-sentence reason.

DEPICTION RULES
- God the Father has no human face or body; use light, cloud, fire or radiance. The Holy Spirit is dove, wind or flame, never human.
- Treat battles, death and crucifixion seriously; avoid lingering gore.
- No sexually explicit content; non-sexual nudity may follow the text.
- Show all peoples with dignity, without ethnic or religious caricature.
- Visionary creatures follow the text, strange and fearsome rather than comic.

- moses (stage: moses-elder, kind: character, hasForm: true): Moses: an old man of about eighty; lean, weathered build; brown skin darkened by desert sun; white hair and a long white beard; deep-set, steady eyes and lined brow; a plain undyed linen tunic belted at the waist with a long dark-brown wool cloak; he carries a wooden shepherd's staff of dark acacia wood, and only he bears the rod of God.
- aaron_brother_of_moses (stage: aaron, kind: character, hasForm: true): Aaron: man in his eighties, older brother of Moses; lean, upright build; olive-brown skin; short grey-streaked beard and close-cropped hair; calm, grave face with deep-set eyes. Signature outfit: a long white linen tunic with a blue robe, a woven ephod of blue, purple and scarlet, a breastplate, and a linen headband. Props: none carried alone; the rod of the Exodus is sometimes held.
- the_levites (stage: the_levites-main, kind: character, hasForm: true): The Levites: men from twenty-five years old upward, of mature working age; sturdy, unhurried build from carrying the tabernacle frames and furnishings; olive-brown skin; short dark hair and close-trimmed beard; calm, dignified features. Signature outfit: a plain undyed linen tunic belted at the waist with a cloak of undyed wool, washed clean; a wooden carrying pole across the shoulders.
- the_tabernacle_portable_sanctuary (stage: tabernacle-main, kind: location, hasForm: true): The tabernacle: a portable sanctuary of a rectangular tent of fine twined linen curtains in blue, purple and scarlet woven with cherubim, over a covering of goats' hair and rams' skins, stretched over upright acacia boards overlaid with gold, set in silver sockets and held by gold-covered bars, enclosed by a court of white linen hangings on bronze pillars.

messages.content:
You check an illustration plan before it is drawn. You get the moment's text with its neighbours, the depiction rules, the section cast (id, name, hasForm), the plan's selected cast ids (`present`), its seven scene fields, the MOMENT CONDITIONS (or literal OWNER LOOK CONSTRAINTS) that rendering will use, and the canon of the selected entries. Report only clear problems that a careful reader would agree with, and return an empty list when the plan is a reasonable illustration of the moment. Do not report preferences, small omissions or other valid readings. Return only JSON.
The text decides who is in the scene; canon decides how they look; the scene plan and moment conditions decide this moment's place, time, light, clothing and action.
Kinds:
- unselected_figure: a section cast entry (a person, group, place, object, or a no-form presence shown as its effect) is clearly depicted in a scene field but its id is not in present. Use its id.
- outside_instant: a selected or described person or presence does not belong in this moment, such as the narrator of a story or vision, someone from a different event, or a no-form presence the moment does not show. Use its id, or empty.
- not_one_instant: the fields give someone incompatible poses or places, or show successive steps as one image.
- embodied_formless: a hasForm false entry is given a body, face, hands, clothing, a silhouette or a seated figure.
- look_conflict: a MOMENT CONDITIONS or OWNER LOOK CONSTRAINTS value contradicts the scene, the text or the depiction rules. Quote that value.
- canon_conflict: a scene field contradicts a selected entry's fixed canon. Quote the scene field.
- missing_canon: the scene depicts a named recurring character or group with no section cast entry. Leave entryId empty.
For each problem, copy a short exact phrase from a scene field or a selected id into planQuote (from a moment condition for look_conflict) and give a one-sentence reason.

DEPICTION RULES
- God the Father has no human face or body; use light, cloud, fire or radiance. The Holy Spirit is dove, wind or flame, never human.
- Treat battles, death and crucifixion seriously; avoid lingering gore.
- No sexually explicit content; non-sexual nudity may follow the text.
- Show all peoples with dignity, without ethnic or religious caricature.
- Visionary creatures follow the text, strange and fearsome rather than comic.

You write a SECTION LOOK for an illustrated edition: one short shared visual description reused by every image of a story section, so that independently generated images of the section agree with each other. Return only JSON.
Rules: each value is one or two short phrases, at most 200 characters. Describe only what stays the same across the whole section: place, time of day, weather, light, and situational clothing or props. Leave out poses, actions and individual moments, and do not restate anyone's fixed appearance; canon does that. If the section spans a change (night into morning), say so once. Obey the work brief's depiction rules. Mention no text or written elements.
Cast marked hasForm: false have no physical body. Use their assigned canon constraints to choose permitted effects for the shared setting. Bodily wording about those subjects in the source is a metaphor, not permission to describe anatomy, hair, clothing, silhouettes or figures made of light in any look field. Do not repeat prohibited features as denials or substitutes, such as a faceless figure or radiance suggesting garments. A seated metaphor permits an unoccupied seat and surrounding effects, not a seated presence. Keep formed characters' own situational clothing and props attached to them; never transfer a no-form subject's bodily metaphors to them.
The complete canon is supplied separately to rendering. Where constraints list effect names for placement, choose only from those effects and leave their fixed colour, brightness and texture to canon. Historical prose constraints may still include the full description. messages.content:
You check an illustration plan before it is drawn. You get the moment's text with its neighbours, the depiction rules, the section cast (id, name, hasForm), the plan's selected cast ids (`present`), its seven scene fields, the MOMENT CONDITIONS (or literal OWNER LOOK CONSTRAINTS) that rendering will use, and the canon of the selected entries. Report only clear problems that a careful reader would agree with, and return an empty list when the plan is a reasonable illustration of the moment. Do not report preferences, small omissions or other valid readings. Return only JSON.
The text decides who is in the scene; canon decides how they look; the scene plan and moment conditions decide this moment's place, time, light, clothing and action.
Kinds:
- unselected_figure: a section cast entry (a person, group, place, object, or a no-form presence shown as its effect) is clearly depicted in a scene field but its id is not in present. Use its id.
- outside_instant: a selected or described person or presence does not belong in this moment, such as the narrator of a story or vision, someone from a different event, or a no-form presence the moment does not show. Use its id, or empty.
- not_one_instant: the fields give someone incompatible poses or places, or show successive steps as one image.
- embodied_formless: a hasForm false entry is given a body, face, hands, clothing, a silhouette or a seated figure.
- look_conflict: a MOMENT CONDITIONS or OWNER LOOK CONSTRAINTS value contradicts the scene, the text or the depiction rules. Quote that value.
- canon_conflict: a scene field contradicts a selected entry's fixed canon. Quote the scene field.
- missing_canon: the scene depicts a named recurring character or group with no section cast entry. Leave entryId empty.
For each problem, copy a short exact phrase from a scene field or a selected id into planQuote (from a moment condition for look_conflict) and give a one-sentence reason.

- unselected_figure: a section cast entry (a person, group, place, object, or a no-form presence shown as its effect) is clearly depicted in a scene field but its id is not in present. Use its id.

Report only clear problems that a careful reader would agree with, and return an empty list when the plan is a reasonable illustration of the moment. Do not report preferences, small omissions or other valid readings. Return only JSON.
The text decides who is in the scene; canon decides how they look; the scene plan and moment conditions decide this moment's place, time, light, clothing and action.
Kinds:
- unselected_figure: a section cast entry (a person, group, place, object, or a no-form presence shown as its effect) is clearly depicted in a scene field but its id is not in present. Use its id.
- outside_instant: a selected or described person or presence does not belong in this moment, such as the narrator of a story or vision, someone from a different event, or a no-form presence the moment does not show. Use its id, or empty.
- not_one_instant: the fields give someone incompatible poses or places, or show successive steps as one image.
- embodied_formless: a hasForm false entry is given a body, face, hands, clothing, a silhouette or a seated figure.
- look_conflict: a MOMENT CONDITIONS or OWNER LOOK CONSTRAINTS value contradicts the scene, the text or the depiction rules. Quote that value.
- canon_conflict: a scene field contradicts a selected entry's fixed canon. Quote the scene field.

- unselected_figure: a section cast entry (a person, group, place, object, or a no-form presence shown as its effect) is clearly depicted in a scene field but its id is not in present. Use its id.

- not_one_instant: the fields give someone incompatible poses or places, or show successive steps as one image.

- look_conflict: a MOMENT CONDITIONS or OWNER LOOK CONSTRAINTS value contradicts the scene, the text or the depiction rules. Quote that value.
